name: EPIC 220502641
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 8, 6.9 solar radii and 1.81 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 220502641 (K2 campaign 8): PARAM radius (solar radii) 6.868779 (16th-84th percentiles 6.656296-7.090641), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

mass.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 220502641 (K2 campaign 8): PARAM mass (solar masses) 1.814848 (16th-84th percentiles 1.688334-1.94907), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

temperature.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 220502641: APOGEE DR17 effective temperature 5088.577 +/- 50 K (the catalogue's final uncertainty)

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 220502641 (K2 campaign 8): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 3695.234375 (16th-84th percentiles 3596.601562-3794.804688), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

color.reason: PARAM fits an extinction A_V = 0.13 mag toward this star (Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, AV-M), and the color routes do not remove extinction; APOGEE measured its temperature

text.card: A red giant 3,695 parsecs away, 7 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 8, give 1.81 solar masses and 6.9 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 5,089 K at its surface.
